The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas in the statistics section, resulting in #NAME? errors.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numerical statistics. This indicates that the generated Excel formulas use undefined names, incorrect function syntax, or missing references. While the 'net metric' assertions passed, the 'statistics' block mismatches suggest a failure in implementing the final calculation layer.
